record.question: Which one of the following statements correctly describes the Dual government arrangement made by the East India company in Bengal?
options: Executive and judicial authority were separated
Revenue collection was entrusted to the deputy Nawab while military affairs were retained by the company
Revenue collection was in the hand of the British while the Nawab depended for his internal and external security on the British.
The new arrangement was made to encourage Indian rulers.
